newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 28.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Ivory Coast's Privatisation Committee advertises sale of two workshops belonging to former state-owned agri-industrial group Palmindustrie. Offer documents available from Privatisation Committee, 6 Boulevard de l'Indenie, Abidjan tel: +225 22 22 31 fax +225 22 22 35 from December 2.
- Ivory Coast's national carrier Air Ivoire starts twice-weekly air service (Wednesday/Friday) to Freetown, Sierra Leone, from December 4, newspaper advertisement says.
- Commission inaugurated to investigate opposition boycott of 1995 presidential elections which led to violence around the poll on October 22, 1995.
- Three La Voie journalistes who have served 11 months of a two-year sentence for insulting the head of state to hear Supreme Court ruling in their appeal today.
- Swine epidemic ravages pig farms around Gangoa, central Ivory Coast; 152 animals killed in one farm in a week.
- Ivorian packaging industry most advanced in Francophone West Africa but still heavily dependent on imported raw material, says article by specialist Michel Tia.
